current.text: Philadelphia added Jaylen Brown and LeBron James, and Joel Embiid is healthier. The projected starting five is Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, LeBron James and Joel Embiid.
Experts expect his usage to drop from about 30 last season to about 27 because Brown, Embiid and LeBron share the ball with him.
He is not expected to stay a top five scorer next to Jaylen Brown.
He is expected to move back toward a shooting guard role, with LeBron James handling more of the playmaking.
Embiid and Anfernee Simons are expected to cut his minutes, possibly to about 36.5 per game.

Experts call his rank of 6 on Yahoo and ESPN too high. They would not take him in the first round or inside the top 10, even with expected injuries to his teammates. One expert would take Kevin Durant ahead of him.
Experts see a fair draft spot around pick 13 to 14.
In a salary cap mock draft he went for 40 USD.
Josh values him at about 40 USD in an auction and is a little lower on him than others.
Philadelphia has 13 back-to-backs, three of them in the fantasy playoffs.
Philadelphia is projected to win about 51 to 52 games. Experts expect growing pains in October and November and load management for the stars.
Embiid is expected to miss games and LeBron to sit games, which can open usage at times.

durable.text: Steals are a league outlier strength for him. He is also strong in FT% on volume, points and threes.
His weakest categories are FG% and rebounds. He has no category weak enough to punt.
He is a very good shooter.
He has made big improvements on defense.
He has missed more games over the last few years than people think.
Nick Nurse plays his starters, and his guards most of all, very heavy minutes.

note: Yahoo's average cost (57.4 USD) and both sites' top 10 ranks are above what experts will pay. The latest mock priced him at about 40 USD, close to the 37 USD he cost in our league last season, so bid in the low 40s and let others overpay. He fits any build because no category is weak. He helps most in FT%, points, threes and steals, but his FG% and turnovers are soft and his Philadelphia team has three back-to-backs in our playoff weeks. Early on, check his shot attempts and minutes next to Brown, LeBron and Embiid: shot attempts near the 19 per game in the projections, down from 21.4, and minutes under 38 would confirm the expected drop.
